verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
There is coming a day
When the Bridegroom is taken away
And in that day they will mourn
In that day they will fast

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
They will say
Things as they are are not okay
When someone is missing
Someone is absent

verse.name: p1
verse.lines:
Things are not okay right now
Things are not okay right now
Things are not okay right now
Things are not okay

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
They won't be 'til You come back
They won't be 'til You come back

verse.name: o1
verse.lines:
I will embrace the ache of a lovesick heart
I will embrace the ache of a lovesick heart

verse.name: o2
verse.lines:
I'll stay here and fast for you
I'll stay here and mourn for you
I'll stay here and wait for you
I'll stay here and watch for you
